title: Mary and Martha

scenes.title: The Good Portion
scenes.note: Luke just says “a village.” John 11 tells us that Mary and Martha lived in Bethany, near Jerusalem.

bsb: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations to be made. She came to Jesus and said,
kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said,

bsb: Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her to help me!
kjv: Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

bsb: you are worried and upset about many things.
kjv: Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

bsb: But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.
kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

puzzles.prompt: What did Mary choose to do?

choices.text: Sit at Jesus' feet and listen

puzzles.hint: Jesus said Mary chose the good portion.

kjv: bid her therefore that she help me.

bsb: But only one thing is necessary.

puzzles.hint: One was busy serving; one was teaching.

bsb: But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.
kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

reflect: Serving is good, but listening to Jesus comes first.
discuss: Martha was busy doing good things. Why did Jesus say Mary chose the better part?
What things keep you busy and “worried and upset”?
When could your family make time to sit and listen to Jesus together?
prayer: Lord Jesus, when we are busy and worried, help us stop and listen to You. You are the one thing we need. Amen.
